adaptations: None. These are unchanged national radar files, with no personal coordinates. Test-derived percentages and cell-center distances are integration calculations, not MeteoSwiss warnings or an endorsement.

unit_evidence.POH: ODIM Table 16: dimensionless [0, 1]. File unit fields are blank, gain 1, offset 0. Convert to percent.
unit_evidence.MESH: File quantity MESH; both unit fields and ODIM Table 16 say mm. Product documentation agrees. The STAC collection description says cm; it is not used for decoding.

geometry: ODIM Table 5 outer pixel corners; section 5.2 rows north to south, columns west to east. Rounded geographic corners in these files disagree with cell-scale extents by less than 10 m.
float_encoding: The POH file includes 0.7999999523162842, exactly float32(80) * float32(0.01) widened to float64. The reader normalizes exact integer-percent float32 encodings only, not nearby arbitrary values.
